dialogues.speaker: Kemia
dialogues.text: The Akademiya welcomes talent from all walks of life. After all, the talented are best known by the want of them.

dialogues.speaker: Kemia
dialogues.text: But some co-workers of mine are rash to recommend everyone. My desk is now inundated with piles of resumes.

dialogues.speaker: Kemia
dialogues.text: With all due respect, most of them... are just garbage.

dialogues.speaker: Kemia
dialogues.text: The more imbeciles we take in, the more stupid things we'll have to deal with every day. It threatens our efficiency. I don't know what's on their mind.
